articles.title: Ukraine says it was behind drone attack that sank a Russian warship in Libya
articles.summary: Ukraine successfully sank a Russian naval corvette in a Libyan port using naval drones on Sunday. This long-range operation, showcasing Ukraine's advanced capabilities, followed another drone strike the previous day on a Russian military-linked cargo ship. These incidents underscore Ukraine's effective use of asymmetric warfare to target Russian naval assets and disrupt their operations, demonstrating an extended reach in the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: China’s military fears US AI could expose its nuclear missiles, NYT reports
articles.summary: Chinese military researchers reportedly fear that rapid US AI advancements could make China's nuclear missile arsenal significantly easier to locate and destroy. This concern, highlighted by The New York Times, underscores an escalating AI arms race, with profound implications for strategic deterrence and global military balance, critically reshaping modern defence strategies.

articles.title: Scientists make astonishing discovery in the deepest place on Earth - and it could explain why the Mariana Trench plunges almost 7 miles beneath the waves
articles.summary: Scientists have made a baffling discovery in Challenger Deep, the Earth's deepest point within the Mariana Trench. This expedition into one of the planet's most extreme and least-understood environments underscores ongoing efforts to unravel deep-sea mysteries. Such findings often reveal unique biological or geological phenomena, expanding our scientific understanding of Earth's furthest reaches.

articles.title: No safe waters for Russian ships? How Ukraine pulled off 2,400-km drone strike in Libya
articles.summary: Ukraine is significantly expanding its naval drone operations, striking Russian targets beyond the Black Sea into the Mediterranean and Baltic Sea. This strategic shift is making it increasingly difficult for Russian ships to find safe waters, highlighting the growing effectiveness and reach of Ukraine's innovative asymmetric naval warfare tactics. This development showcases evolving naval combat strategies.

articles.title: Shraddha Arya talks about going from being excited for surprises to finding contentment in five years of marriage
articles.summary: Mumbai-based actress Shraddha Arya recently shared that her priorities concerning marriage have significantly changed over time. She specifically disclosed that in the initial phase of her relationship, she committed a substantial amount of effort and energy. The ongoing report elaborates on these evolving perspectives and what led to the shifts in her approach to her marital life.

articles.title: India closes gap with China in 2026 Asia Power Index, Lowy report says
articles.summary: The Lowy Institute's 2026 Asia Power Index has classified India as a "major power," ranking it third in comprehensive power across Asia. This assessment positions India above "middle powers," underscoring its escalating strategic influence and significance on the regional stage. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's growing geopolitical importance and increasing global stature.

articles.title: Zelenskiy confirms Ukraine sank Russian warship in Libya
articles.summary: Ukraine's President Zelenskiy confirmed the sinking of the Russian naval corvette 'Merkury' in a Libyan port, reportedly using seven naval drones. This marks a significant naval engagement, showcasing Ukraine's evolving drone warfare tactics against Russian assets. The incident underscores the ongoing conflict's reach and advanced technological aspects, following other recent drone strikes on Russian military-linked targets.

articles.title: olee.space gets DRDO contract for laser-based drone communication system
articles.summary: Pune-based deep-tech company olee.space has secured a significant contract from DRDO, the Defence Ministry's research and development arm. The agreement tasks olee.space with developing a cutting-edge laser-link communication system for drones. This initiative boosts India's indigenous defence technology capabilities, focusing on advanced, secure, and high-bandwidth drone communication crucial for modern military operations and national security.

articles.title: aiquants-platform-fastapi added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article snippet discusses core building blocks for securing and structuring APIs using FastAPI. It highlights shared components like a single 'guard' for authentication, tenant binding, and authorization, along with a unified route class for consistent error handling. The text delves into technical architecture for robust and secure platform APIs, emphasizing standardized development practices in software engineering.
